findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: youtube_comments, youtube_transcript, hackernews_item, reviews, googleplay_reviews, webcontext_scrape, webcontext_crawl, webcontext_map, webcontext_brand, brand_retrieve, brand_styleguide, brand_fonts, brand_logo, search_posts, subreddit_posts, post_by_id, post_by_permalink, user_posts · Private data: get_fetcher_readyz, hackernews_stories_top, hackernews_stories_new, hackernews_stories_best, hackernews_stories_ask, hackernews_stories_show, hackernews_stories_job, hackernews_search, hackernews_item, hackernews_user, app, list, search, developer, privacy, suggest, similar, reviews, ratings, googleplay_app_details, googleplay_search, googleplay_similar_apps, googleplay_permissions, googleplay_reviews, googleplay_developer, googleplay_categories, googleplay_category_apps, googleplay_suggest, googleplay_availability, googleplay_data_safety, monitor_update · Public sink: post_by_id, post_by_permalink, monitor_create, monitor_update.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: youtube_comments, youtube_transcript, hackernews_item, reviews, googleplay_reviews, webcontext_scrape, webcontext_crawl, webcontext_map, webcontext_brand, brand_retrieve, brand_styleguide, brand_fonts, brand_logo, search_posts, subreddit_posts, post_by_id, post_by_permalink, user_posts · Private data: get_fetcher_readyz, hackernews_stories_top, hackernews_stories_new, hackernews_stories_best, hackernews_stories_ask, hackernews_stories_show, hackernews_stories_job, hackernews_search, hackernews_item, hackernews_user, app, list, search, developer, privacy, suggest, similar, reviews, ratings, googleplay_app_details, googleplay_search, googleplay_similar_apps, googleplay_permissions, googleplay_reviews, googleplay_developer, googleplay_categories, googleplay_category_apps, googleplay_suggest, googleplay_availability, googleplay_data_safety, monitor_update · Public sink: post_by_id, post_by_permalink, monitor_create, monitor_update

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
